statement: Warren 2026-10-16: Compuspeed LTD (1152) and SYNTECH DISTRIBUTION (PTY) LTD (4145) are real distributors, not placeholders, and are NOT to be merged into OPEN_CHANNEL. Closes the N-0095 question whether those absorbs were intended: they were not. cip still holds both merged into OPEN_CHANNEL; undoing them is a cip data write that was not made in N-0111 (no cip writes in that node) and needs its own go-ahead.
